blockingFindings.contract: .omo/drafts/leftovers.md:68 excludes staples only from coverage, then defines expiry as captured weight divided by total expiry weight.
evidence: Production builds available by filtering hardcoded commonStaples before both coverage and expiry calculations.
expiryTotal and capturedExpiry both use available, so an expiring tracked staple contributes no urgency weight although the approved expiry definition says total expiry weight.

blockingFindings.requiredFix: Separate the coverage staple domain from the expiry-weight domain and define a locale-safe deterministic staple rule or explicit pantry property, with boundary fixtures.
